segments.text: The artist Van Gogh could barely sell any of his paintings
During his lifetime he was rejected and criticized by ordinary people
And experienced severe mental distress
Just before he took his own life at 37
He had sold only one painting
Without the support of his brother Theo
He could not even have bought paint
Despite all this, Van Gogh created about 200 works in 10 years
Paintings and drawings, an enormous number together
His dedication was not in pursuit of success
Decades after his death, his paintings began to be re-evaluated
Today, sunflowers and the starry night
Are counted among the most popular paintings in the world
They are traded for billions of yen each
While Van Gogh was alive
Few people recognized his potential
His brother Theo was one of the few exceptions
Theo believed in his brother's talent
And that considerable sacrifice
Kept supporting him
Van Gogh's story asks about the definition of success
Is success to be recognized in life?
Life is success to be recognized after death
Perhaps for Van Gogh himself, success was to keep painting
Whatever the reaction of the world he kept painting
According to his inner voice
That was the integrity of his life
We can see the truth of a human being in the canvases
Van Gogh left behind
Colors that seem to yell
A life force that seems to burst
Instead of staying silent
He continues to speak to the world
Through his paintings
Mmm
